title: How To Make $1,000/Day Trading Futures (Easy Strategy)

strategies.name: overnight_range_breakout_and_retest_strategy

entry_sequence.action: Identify the highest point (Overnight High/Pre-market High) and the lowest point (Overnight Low/Pre-market Low) of price action during the overnight and pre-market session (4:00 PM EST to 9:30 AM EST).
entry_sequence.rationale: These zones define the range for the trading session.

entry_sequence.action: Wait for price to break above the overnight high or break below the overnight low with strength or weakness.
entry_sequence.rationale: A strong break confirms the likely direction of the move.

entry_sequence.action: Wait for price to pull back and retest the broken level (Overnight High/Low).
entry_sequence.rationale: The retest provides a high-probability entry point.

entry_sequence.action: Enter long when price shows bullish price action (e.g., bullish hammer, bullish engulfing, dragonfly dogee, long lower wicks, and an elevation in volume) at the retested overnight high.
entry_sequence.rationale: Bullish price action confirms the overnight high is now acting as support.

entry_sequence.action: Enter short when price shows bearish price action (e.g., bearish hammer, gravestone dogee, long upper wick, bearish engulfing, as well as an elevation in volume) at the retested overnight low.
entry_sequence.rationale: Bearish price action confirms the overnight low is now acting as resistance.

stop.rationale: The stop is placed if price breaks back down below the previous high (for long) or breaks above the previous low (for short).

strategies.stop_management: Once in profit, take the first trim, then move the stop-loss to break-even.

targets.rationale: The speaker demonstrated a potential 2.6R trade in one example.
